001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005import pkg_entities.MovingTrainer;
006
007/**
008 * Implements the {@code back} command, moving the player to the previous room when possible.
009 *
010 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
011 * @version 2026.05.08
012 */
013public class BackCommand extends Command {
014    /** Creates the command. */
015    public BackCommand() {}
016
017    /**
018     * Moves the player to the previous room and refreshes room output.
019     *
020     * @param pGameEngine the game engine containing player history
021     * @return always {@code false}; this command does not end the game
022     */
023    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
024        if (this.hasSecondWord()) {
025            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Back what?");
026            return false;
027    }
028
029        if (!pGameEngine.getPlayer().canGoBack()) {
030            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Can't go back, you just started!");
031        } else if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().isExit(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getPreviousRoom()) == false) {
032            pGameEngine.getGui().println("There is no door!");
033            return false;
034        } else {
035            pGameEngine.getPlayer().goBack();
036            pGameEngine.getGui().println(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getLongDescription());
037            if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getImageName() != null) {
038                pGameEngine.getGui().showImage(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getImageName());
039                if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem("map") != null) {
040                    pGameEngine.getGui().showMap(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getMapImageName());
041                }
042            }
043            for (MovingTrainer vMovingTrainer : pGameEngine.getMovingTrainers()) {
044                vMovingTrainer.tryMove();
045            }
046            if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem("delta-orb") != null && pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().isWinningRoom()) {
047                pGameEngine.getGui().println("\n" + "You want to keep winning, don't you?");
048            }
049        }
050        return false;
051    } // execute()
052}
